# Miles To Go

> Miles To Go keeps small businesses' Google listings and websites right, so people find them, like what they see, and call. Owner: Michael Wagner. It starts with a free checkup, delivered within two business days.

## Services and prices

- Free checkup: a one-page look at search results, Google Business Profile, reviews and website.
- Google Profile Tune-Up: $350. Website Tune-Up: $350. Both Tune-Ups: $600.
- Move Your Existing Website: from $600. Your New Landing Page: $950. Your New Website: from $2,500.
- Monthly plans: Watch $79, Care $249, Grow from $549. Cancel anytime; the client owns their domain, accounts and logins.
